name: config_power_cut
description: One hundred configuration writes, then twenty writes interrupted by pulling power mid-transfer. After every cut the device must come back holding either the old configuration or the new one - never a mixture, and never nothing.
requires: A host running the configurator or its CDC client

steps.note: one per cycle, cycling through the list

values: the package that was being written

steps.note: the device booted into a configuration it could parse

checks.no_torn_configuration: every power cut left a complete old or complete new configuration
checks.never_unconfigured: the device never came back with no usable configuration
checks.generation_monotonic: the generation counter never went backwards
